skill.displayName: Big8 · 算八字·玄学算命助手（八字排盘·算命·风水·面相·星座·每日一卦）| Chinese Fortune Telling, Feng Shui & BaZi

llm.summary: This is a coherent fortune-telling skill, but its selfie face-reading feature handles sensitive facial images while making privacy claims that are not specific enough about vision-model processing.

dimensions.detail: The advertised purpose matches the artifacts: feng shui image analysis, face reading from selfies, BaZi calculations, zodiac, divination, and almanac output.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to analyze selfies and infer face-reading traits, but its privacy language only says photos are not stored or transferred and does not clearly explain where the vision model processes facial images.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains normal markdown, one Python helper script, and YAML knowledge files; metadata and static scan show no declared dependency or static-scan findings, and the script contains no network upload or persistence logic.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Image analysis is purpose-aligned, but selfies are sensitive biometric-adjacent data and the entertainment use case needs clearer pre-upload disclosure and consent than the artifact currently provides.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact claims photos are used only for the current analysis and not stored, and no local code was found that writes or retains images; however, retention by the vision-model provider is not addressed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with users uploading room photos, selfies, and birth details for entertainment analysis. The skill does not show hidden exfiltration or destructive behavior, but its publisher should clarify vision-model processing, provider retention/logging, and add explicit consent before selfie-based face reading.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The face-reading feature itself is expected, but the plan’s claim that face images are not uploaded to any third party is not well supported because the same artifact relies on a Vision Model without specifying whether that processing is local or provider-hosted.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Requesting selfies is core to the skill, but the artifacts do not provide a prominent biometric/privacy disclosure or explain processing, logging, retention, and consent before analysis.
